subject: forestpath
name: 林间小路
label: 两棵树间的小路
learning: 先看大的轮廓，再挑一两处喜欢的地方画。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. BEGINNER reference: a warm simple picture-book drawing, 3–5 large easy-to-read forms and a small number of necessary interior marks. Broad rounded organic silhouettes; no repetitive decoration. A simple forest path vignette with two round-canopy trees and one broad curving path between them.
The drawing fits completely within generous clear margins, with every part visible. A small number of long purposeful contours, no texture, no tiny repeated marks, no extra scenery or extra objects. Tree foliage if present is a few broad shapes, not clusters of tiny scallops.
